# PixelFX

Source: https://github.com/patch-gg/pixelfx
Revision: a84159688af3ca37a4be05a0d422b94451b2e24e

Pinned core and all 244 effect modules. MIT licenses and attribution are retained in LICENSE, NOTICE.md and source headers. Gallery and its separately licensed Patch Pixel font are not included. Wildbound integration lives outside this directory.

Wildbound adaptations (2026-11-17): chained effects forward a supplied native actor mask; life-steal accepts a real target point. Gameplay-only options suppress gallery torch/log/chest props, fake loot/HUD counts, electrical test hardware and weather/water backdrops. Defaults preserve the original gallery appearance. The storage portal also has the separately documented depthFloor option. Native actor capture, gameplay bindings and caching live outside this directory.

2026-11-21: gameplay splash instances begin at the crown impact, skipping the gallery's falling-stone lead-in. Gallery playback remains unchanged.
